messages.relationshipStubsDisabled: Create or update children through their initiative type, stage or initiative fields, not relationship ID lists.
messages.cannotChangeInitiative: A relation cannot be moved to another initiative.
messages.relationTypeMismatch: The relation must belong to the initiative's type.
messages.selfParent: An initiative cannot be related to itself.
messages.duplicateParent: This related record is already linked to the initiative.
messages.cannotReparent: A stage or initiative cannot be reassigned to another initiative type.
messages.initiativeTypeRequired: Select an existing initiative type with an owning tenant.
messages.tenantMismatch: The tenant must match the initiative type tenant.
messages.notAccessible: The selected record is not accessible.
messages.teamsRequired: Select teams belonging to one tenant.
messages.teamsMismatch: Every initiative type team must belong to the same tenant.
messages.cannotChangeTenant: An initiative type cannot be moved to another tenant.
messages.stageMismatch: The selected stage must belong to the selected initiative type.
messages.inactiveEntry: Initiatives can only enter active types and stages.
messages.invalidStatus: Status must be On Hold, To Do, Doing or Done.
messages.targetTenantMismatch: The related record must belong to the initiative tenant.
messages.assigneeTenantMismatch: The assigned user must belong to the initiative tenant.
messages.initiativeTypeInUse: This initiative type has stages or initiatives. Deactivate it instead of deleting it.
messages.stageInUse: This stage has initiatives. Deactivate it instead of deleting it.
messages.useRecordFields: Update the record fields instead of linking or unlinking this relationship.
